findings.rootCause: Reconciliation of every critique item against the code in the worktree. Blockers: none in the critique. MAJOR 3.1.4 (mixed sameTerm/= disjunction lost rows under the TERM classification): handled in b2. LmdbJoinPlanSupport.containsSameTerm and LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer.requiresTermIdentityFilter keep the sameTerm condition next to the value-expanded superset anchor. Guarded by LmdbFiniteAnchorEqualityTest#mixedSameTermAndEqualityDisjunctionKeepsOnlyValueEqualRow and #mixedSameTermAndEqualityDisjunctionKeepsEveryValueEqualDatatype, which is exactly the critique's suggested `sameTerm(?o,7) || ?o = 8` over "8"^^int and "8"^^integer. MAJOR 3.1.1 (sub-SELECT rule regressed the spec-correct BOUND->FALSE fold): handled in b1. OuterScopeBindings.OuterScope has a third set possibleInScope; LmdbBoundSimplifierOptimizer blocks the FALSE fold only on possibleInScope, and a sub-SELECT/MINUS boundary makes outer names leak-only. Guarded by LmdbCorrelatedScopeRewriteTest#boundOfOuterNameInsideSubSelectIsFalseBySpec, #...WithinExistsIsFalseBySpec, #boundOfOuterNameInsideMinusIsFalseBySpec and LmdbBoundSimplifierOptimizerTest#stillFolds*. MAJOR 3.1.6 (legacy stores with duplicate ids for case variants, Option A vs B): handled in b3. Option B keeps the canonical lower-cased data->id key and preserves the first spelling as the payload. A legacy store is migrated on open in one write transaction; if two ids already denote one term it stays byte-exact and a warning names export/re-import, so a subset is never returned silently. Guarded by ValueStoreLanguageTagKeyMigrationTest#legacyStoreWithCollidingVariantsStaysByteExact. The critique's full merge migration was NOT implemented (follow-up). MINOR 3.5: b2 publishes weakenings before mdb_txn_commit and uses a pendingRdfTermDomainCacheMayStrengthen flag rather than unconditional pre-commit publication plus a comment. Re-verified this batch: the flag is set only by rebuildRdfTermDomain(long)/stageRdfTermDomainCacheClear, which are reachable only from initializeRdfTermDomains at open, so every runtime commit publishes before commit (sound). The critique's 'failed commit does not throw from the cache path' test was not added: applyPendingRdfTermDomainCacheUpdates is pure heap work and a deterministic mdb_txn_commit failure needs disk-full injection. MINOR 3.1.1 rule (c)/LATERAL: done in b1 (Join/LeftJoin only; Difference leak-only; Union contributes nothing; Lateral.getRightInputBindingNames used for possible, and left assured is intersected with it for assured). MINOR 3.1.1 scope-changed control: LmdbBoundSimplifierOptimizerTest#leavesScopeChangedFilterOnOptionalRightSideUntouched exists. Checked this batch that FilterMerger.canMerge (LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer:327-329) refuses to merge when either filter is scope-changing. The control runs on both the LMDB pipeline and the DefaultEvaluationStrategyFactory oracle (FilterOptimizer is wp9's). MINOR 3.1.4 disjunction repros: ported as sameTermIntegerDisjunctionIsNotValueEquality / sameTermBooleanDisjunctionIsNotValueEquality, which were green before the fix. They are controls, not Hit Proof; Hit Proof comes from the OPTIONAL variants and the algebra-level tests, as the critique asked. MINOR 3.1.5 upgrade behaviour: both auto-rebuild settings are tested in b2 (LmdbPredicateObjectDomainIndexTest#booleanGuaranteeUpgradeRebuildsCanonicalBooleanFact / #booleanGuaranteeUpgradeWithAutoRebuildDisabledClearsGuaranteesAndKeepsFilter). missedFindings: (1) W3C lang-3 over LMDB: there is no LMDB SPARQL10QueryComplianceTest subclass in this repo; LmdbLanguageTagTermIdentityTest#plainPatternWithCaseVariantTagWarm/ColdStore covers the same shape on both pipelines. (2) LmdbLiteral.equals id comparison with duplicate ids: this now only affects legacy byte-exact stores (documented follow-up). Design additional tests that were missing: added three controls this batch (see change). Repro methods c4_*, c6_*, c7_* and oracle_sameTermInsideExistsSeesOuterBinding belong to candidates outside 3.1/3.5 (refuted hoist finding, LmdbSetSemanticsOptimizer, LmdbOptionalNormalFormOptimizer, and the wp9 SameTermFilterOptimizer oracle blind spot), so they were not ported.
findings.change: Test-only additions. LmdbFiniteAnchorEqualityTest gains an uncommittedScenario harness, mirroring the repro's inTransaction: commit, warm the plan, then query inside an open transaction with added rows. It also gains three controls from the design (3.1.4 'uncommitted-transaction variant unchanged') and from the repro controls: controlEqualityIntegerFamilyWithNonCanonicalCommittedRow (repro c5_integerFamilyNonCanonicalCommitted), controlEqualityIntegerWithUncommittedNonCanonicalRow (repro c5_integerAnchorWithUncommittedNonCanonicalRow) and sameTermIntegerWithUncommittedValueEqualRow. All three pass, so no production change was needed. Style pass over the cumulative diff: rewrapped the 8 added lines longer than 120 columns (javadoc in ValueStore/StoreProperties, two test statements). No debug prints, TODOs, commented-out code, wildcard imports or inline fully-qualified names among the added lines. All 8 new files carry the exact 2026 header plus '// Some portions generated by Claude'. The remaining long lines and unused imports in touched files (PackedLogicalRuleProgram, LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer:94, TripleStore:169/236, ValueStore SimpleIRI import) predate this work package (git blame / HEAD).
